name: Omni-fMRI Benchmark Suite
description: A comprehensive benchmark suite spanning 11 fMRI datasets and diverse resting-state and task-based fMRI tasks, designed to evaluate atlas-free foundation models operating on voxel-level signals for brain representation learning.
reputation: A newly proposed benchmark suite for atlas-free fMRI foundation models, with emerging interest but limited established adoption so far.
notes: Benchmark suite enables reproducibility and fair comparison for atlas-free fMRI foundation models.
